verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Inference Providers APIs, a chat-completion playground and model hosting. These are building blocks a developer could use to run models. None of it describes an in-product feature that generates insights or suggestions from a user's own data, such as their datasets, repos or usage. The axis applies to an ML hub platform, but there is no evidence the capability ships.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
